svg.title: Two enlarged cross-sections of a small tungsten plug set flush in a flat pale oxide over a thin purple pad. Before the step the top is flat oxide with the plug's top showing. After it three blanket films cover the whole top: a thin purple film, a thick silver film with diagonal lines, and another thin purple film.
svg.desc: Two enlarged cross-sections of a small tungsten plug set flush in a flat pale oxide over a thin purple pad. Before the step the top is flat oxide with the plug's top showing. After it three blanket films cover the whole top: a thin purple film, a thick silver film with diagonal lines, and another thin purple film.
svg.text: A bottom film, the aluminium–copper and
a cap are sputtered over the whole wafer.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
